selection_rule: Scan frozen_pool_rank upward; retain the earliest exact-runtime-executable record from each distinct model and training family; exclude every case used to develop Training Bias Profile v2.

measurement.primary_update_mapping: cold-start AdamW, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95, epsilon=1e-8, weight_decay=0
required_checks: candidate and repair start from the same complete state
repair changes only the declared implementation boundary
all finite nonzero and zero results are retained
failed boundaries produce ABSTAIN rather than an estimated value

branches_for_every_case: change aligned with the normal repair update
remaining direction after removing aligned scaling
analysis.primary_family: all three update-stage branches for all four frozen cases
analysis.interpretation_rule: A new form is reported only when a held-out update-stage branch survives the frozen family correction. Local and gradient stages explain where it appeared; they do not replace the update verdict.

reporting_rule: Report all four rows, including centered, unresolved, and abstaining cases. This batch estimates method behavior on these frozen cases, not prevalence over all LLM operators.
